identity.title: Molecular ion abundances in the diffuse ISM: CF<SUP>+</SUP>, HCO<SUP>+</SUP>, HOC<SUP>+</SUP>, and C<SUB>3</SUB>H<SUP>+</SUP>

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present ALMA Cycle 2 observations under project 2013.1.1194.S

question.value: Can HCO+, HOC+ and CF+ (and C3H+) absorption serve as probes of diffuse molecular hydrogen, and what are their abundances relative to H2 and implications for chemistry?

evidence.quote: In this paper we focus on three possible probes of the molecular hydrogen column density, HCO$^+$, HOC$^+$, and CF$^+$.
We present ALMA Cycle 2 observations under project 2013.1.1194.S
ADS/JAO.ALMA#2013.1.01194.S

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 61.03 kHz (0.18 km/s) for CF+, 122.07 kHz (0.4 km/s) for HOC+, 244.14 kHz (0.8 km/s) for the other lines

evidence.quote: with spectral resolution set to 61.03 kHz (0.18 $\mathrm{\,km~s^{-1}}$) for CF$^+$, 122.07 kHz (0.4 $\mathrm{\,km~s^{-1}}$) for HOC$^+$

continuum_bandwidth.value: 1.875 GHz wide window with 15.6 MHz resolution at 102 GHz

evidence.quote: A 1.875 GHz wide spectral window with a coarse spectral resolution of 15.6 MHz was reserved for detecting the continuum emission at 102 GHz with high sensitivity.

configurations.value: three scheduling blocks observed in different interferometer configurations, 2014-2015

evidence.quote: Observations were divided in three scheduling blocks that have been observed separately in different interferometer configurations between 2014 and 2015.
we obtain a noise level between 0.2 and 0.6 % of the continuum brightness when smoothed at the common velocity resolution of 1 $\mathrm{\,km~s^{-1}}$

provided.value: HF, p-H2O and CH absorption spectra for comparison

evidence.quote: These data are compared with Herschel absorption spectra of the ground state transition of HF and p-H$_2$O.
The *Herschel* and ALMA data are complemented by absorption data of HCO$^+$ and CCH using the IRAM-30m telescope

what.value: Herschel HF and p-H2O absorption spectra

evidence.quote: We have compared the absorption profiles of both ions with those of p-H$_2$O and HF detected by *Herschel* (cite: sonnentrucker:15).

what.value: CH abundance relative to H2 of 3.6e-8

evidence.quote: \[CH\] = $3.6 \times 10^{-8}$ (cite: sheffer:08)

what.value: Herschel CH absorption to derive H2 column densities

evidence.quote: using the *Herschel* CH absorption measurements (cite: gerin:10) to derive the H$_2$ column densities
the H$_2$ column density has been derived using the mean reddening E(B-V) from (cite: schlegel:98)
using the reaction rates from (cite: nw:09) as listed in Table [\[tab:rates\]](#tab:rates)

pipeline_or_manual.value: calibrated and deconvolved with CASA; version not stated

evidence.quote: The data were calibrated and deconvolved using CASA and the resulting data-cubes were then exported to GILDAS for further analysis.
As flux calibrator the solar system objects Titan, Venus, and Ceres were used.

continuum_subtraction.value: continuum level determined separately in each spectral window; spectra divided by continuum

evidence.quote: The continuum level to be subtracted to measure the strength of the absorption was determined separately in each spectral window.
For further analysis the data have been smoothed at a spectral resolution of 1 $\mathrm{\,km~s^{-1}}$.

what.value: Chemical scheme for HOC+/H2O steady state

evidence.quote: Following (cite: liszt:04), and using the chemical scheme described in Appendix [10](#app:chem)

what.value: Some of the project observations (B1741-312) previously presented

evidence.quote: Some of the observations under this project were previously presented by (cite: gerin:17)

unstated_but_needed: CASA version and calibration/imaging parameters (weighting, cell, masks)
Exact line-free channels / continuum level choice per window
Pixels and weights used for averaged spectra

Uncertainty estimation for column densities and fit errors

method.value: Spectra extracted at continuum peak or weighted average of bright pixels, divided by continuum, smoothed to 1 km/s

evidence.quote: The absorption spectra have been obtained by dividing the observed spectra by the continuum intensity in the same band.

method.value: Gaussian fits to H66epsilon recombination line and narrow CH3OH/ethanol absorption; line ID with Splatalogue, CDMS, JPL

evidence.quote: We have fit the narrow absorption lines with Gaussian profiles, and used the residual to estimate the absorption due to C$_3$H$^+$ along the G10.62-0.4 line of sight.
We have fit the narrow absorption lines with Gaussian profiles

method.value: Integrate opacity over velocity intervals using N/∫τdv coefficients

evidence.quote: The column densities have been derived by integrating the line opacity over selected velocity intervals

assumptions.value: Level populations in equilibrium with CMB (2.725 K)

evidence.quote: we have assumed that the level population is in equilibrium with the Cosmic Microwave Background

method.value: Least-squares fits assuming proportionality, restricted to SNR>2.5 sigma and opacity<3.5, Galactic disk sightlines only

evidence.quote: assuming the column densities are proportional to each other and restraining the fit to points with SNR greater than 2.5$\sigma$ and opacity lower than 3.5

We obtained the following relationships from least square fits, assuming the column densities are proportional to each other and restraining the fit to points with SNR greater than 2.5$\sigma$ and opacity lower than 3.5

method.value: HCO+ abundance from CH-derived N(H2), then other ions from ratios to HCO+

evidence.quote: Using the HCO$^+$ abundance as reference, with \[HCO$^+$\] = $3\times 10^{-9}$, we list in Table [\[tab:abundances\]](#tab:abundances) the abundances relative to H$_2$
\[CH\] = $3.6 \times 10^{-8}$ (cite: sheffer:08)

method.value: Analytic steady-state formulae for HOC+/H2O and CF+/HF with Langevin or enhanced capture rates

evidence.quote: the ratios of the HOC$^+$ and H$_2$O abundances at steady state can be written

assumptions.value: C+ main carbon carrier and electron source

evidence.quote: We further assume that C$^+$ is the main carrier of carbon and all electrons are provided by C$^+$
The data were calibrated and deconvolved using CASA
the resulting data-cubes were then exported to GILDAS for further analysis
We used Splatalogue [^1] and the CDMS[^2] and JPL[^3] line catalogs for line identification and assignment.
The reaction rate coefficients have been taken from the online database KIDA
a mean value of \[HCO$^+$\] = $3.1 \times 10^{-9}$ and a moderate scatter of 0.21 dex

findings_qualitative.value: CF+ abundance lower than predicted; formation rate of C+ + HF should be lowered by factor ~3

evidence.quote: the rate coefficient of reaction R5 used by (cite: nw:09) is too high and should be revised downward by a factor of about $\sim 5.3/1.7 \sim 3$

claims.hypothesis: HCO+, HOC+ and CF+ are correlated with each other and with Herschel hydrides
claims.experiment: Channel-by-channel comparison of ALMA and Herschel absorption
claims.result: Nearly linear relations with p-H2O and HF in the disk; SgrB2 differs
claims.finding: Tight correlations for disk gas, different pattern near Galactic center

evidence.quote: We show that the HCO$^+$, HOC$^+$, and CF$^+$ column densities are well correlated with each other.

claims.hypothesis: CF+ abundance matches simple chemical model
claims.experiment: Compare observed CF+/HF with steady-state prediction
claims.finding: Formation rate lower by about factor 3

evidence.quote: We confirm that the CF$^+$ abundance is lower than predicted by simple chemical models

claims.hypothesis: C3H+ is ubiquitous in diffuse gas
claims.experiment: Absorption detection toward G10.62, G5.89, SgrB2

evidence.quote: We report new detections of C$_3$H$^+$ confirming that this ion is ubiquitous in the diffuse matter

why_this_data.value: Ground-state lines of these ions are at mm wavelengths accessible from ground, unlike HF and H2O

evidence.quote: The ground state transitions of the three molecular ions discussed here are located at millimeter wavelengths where the atmospheric transmission is excellent.

limitations_admitted.value: CF+ and C3H+ lines are weak and contaminated; Galactic center abundances cannot be determined absolutely

evidence.quote: Absolute abundances cannot be determined in the central molecular zone because the relative abundances of the usual H$_2$-tracers (CH, HF, etc) have not been established in this region

referee_caveats_inferred: Abundances rest on a single CH/H2 ratio and Herschel CH data
No stated treatment of non-CMB excitation or uncertainty propagation
Chemical modeling is analytic steady state only

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: ~50-200 GB raw for three scheduling blocks
reproducibility.score_reason: Public ALMA data and clear formulas, but calibration, imaging and extraction details are sparse and Herschel data are needed.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Recipe incomplete and requires Herschel data and external abundances.
